goal: Close the modal window that appears on page load, so that the page's own content, including the 'click here' link that re-enables the ad, can be used.

checks.modal_open: A modal window is shown over the page
checks.content_usable: The 'Entry Ad' heading and a 'click here' link are visible and not covered

modal_closed.when: No modal window covers the page and the 'Entry Ad' heading with its 'click here' link is visible
